```{r}
library(tidyverse) # For data wrangling
library(brms) # For stats
library(ggeffects) # for plotting model predictions
# Note: I needed to also install the `insight` and `see` packages to get `modelbased` to install properly; try that if you get similar error messages 
#install.packages('insight')
library(insight)
#install.packages('see')
library(see)
#install.packages('modelbased') # if you need to install this package
library(modelbased) # for plotting model predictions. supports the link scale (ggeffects does not)
#install.packages('faraway') # if you need to install this package
library(faraway) # For data on galapagos species richess
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

## Data Searching

```{r}
kelp_no3_quarterly <- read.csv(here("kelp_no3_waves_quarterly_long.csv"))
kelp_no3_annual = read.csv(here("kelp_no3_waves_annual_long.csv"))
# display the first 6 rows
head(kelp_no3_quarterly)
head(kelp_no3_annual)
```

```{r}
p.basic.quarterly.nitrate = ggplot(data = kelp_no3_quarterly, aes(x = no3, y = kelp))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

p.basic.quarterly.nitrate
```

```{r}
p.basic.annual.nitrate = ggplot(data = kelp_no3_annual, aes(x = no3, y = kelp))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

p.basic.annual.nitrate
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hexbin-annual
#| fig-cap: "Hexagonal binning showing the density of observations for kelp abundance and nitrate."

ggplot(data = kelp_no3_annual, aes(x = no3, y = kelp)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 30) + # Adjust 'bins' to make hexes larger or smaller
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + # A visually appealing, colorblind-friendly scale
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density of Kelp Abundance vs. Nitrate",
    x = "Nitrate Concentration (NO3)",
    y = "Kelp Abundance",
    fill = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
p.basic.annual.waves = ggplot(data = kelp_no3_annual, aes(x = waves, y = kelp))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

p.basic.annual.waves
```
